firm_data.firm_description: The New York City Law Department provides legal services and advice to the Mayor, City agencies, and elected officials in New York City. The Law Department represents the City, the Mayor, other elected officials, and the City's many agencies in all affirmative and defensive civil litigation, as well as juvenile delinquency proceedings brought in Family Court and Administrative Code enforcement proceedings brought in Family Court and Administrative Code enforcement proceedings brought in Criminal Court.
notable_facts: Represents the City of New York in legal matters
The Law Department is comprised of 17 legal divisions and 3 support divisions.
Staffed with 690 lawyers and 850 support professionals in 10 offices located in all five boroughs, as well as in Kingston, N.Y.
